fundamentals_narrative: FY26 looked outstanding on the P&L - revenue Rs 210.5 Cr (+69%), EBITDA Rs 60 Cr (+103%, margin +483 bps to 28.7%), PAT Rs 42.4 Cr (+87%), ROCE 30.6% - driven by a structural government mandate (Kavach national safety rollout, ~Rs 1.3 trillion planned railway safety spend) and a Rs 697 Cr order book that is 3.3x FY26 revenue and up 228% YoY (including ~Rs 139 Cr of loco wireless control and ~Rs 239-280 Cr of Kavach 4.0 via associate Progota). The deep read, however, sharpens the two cautions from the sentiment pass into hard problems. First, cash: FY26 operating cash flow was NEGATIVE Rs 55 Cr (FCF -Rs 63 Cr) against Rs 42 Cr of reported profit - trade receivables tripled to Rs 121 Cr, inventory rose to Rs 89 Cr, and the company took on Rs 39-54 Cr of fresh short-term debt (from ~zero) to fund it; management gave no normalisation timeline and said the pattern 'may persist'. Second, certification: Kavach 4.0 is SIL-4 certified with RDSO prototype clearance and field trials underway, but final RDSO / ISA approval is still not in hand, with only a 'hope' for FY27 - the exact gap a trusted forum user flagged via the GG Tronics precedent (a developmental vendor whose orders were cancelled when final certification did not come through). On top of this, FY27 guidance itself points to EBITDA margin normalising down to 20-25%, promoter holding has fallen ~8 points in three years, and the stock trades at 55.8x earnings / 11.3x book. Positives: marquee investors (SageOne, Ashish Kacholia) took the Jan 2026 preferential issue, and a BSE-SME -> main-board migration with direct NSE listing is underway (postal ballot to 19 Sep 2026).
technical_read: Not checked -- forum-flagged 'sell the news' pullback after the SME-to-main-board migration approval (per sameernics, Aug 2026) is itself a form of price signal worth future tracking rather than a chart pull this pass.
